$comment: The quality contract, as a reviewable file. Changing a limit here is a
diff someone approves, not a number edited in a dashboard.
'floor' is an absolute minimum every run must clear.
'maxRegression' is how far a check may fall against the baseline run,
as an absolute drop in the 0-1 score.
answer_accuracy and aggregate_discipline are held tight, because for
those an absolute number means something: a count that does not match
the warehouse is wrong at any threshold.
query_efficiency deliberately has NO floor. It rewards running fewer
queries, so a floor would push toward exactly the behaviour the other
two exist to prevent. It is gated on regression only and read beside
